lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hello Survivalist!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: This is Tove.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'm a new recruit from Unlimited.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'm also a survival expert.
I know you, haha.
Have you found your place within the squad?
Have you been able to use any of your survival skills?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I figured since it was my first time texting you I should still introduce myself.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I have.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: In an environment as harsh and unforgiving as the Northern Base,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: a survival expert like me is practically indispensable.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Every day.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: We are in the north, after all.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: This is a place with rough terrain and severe weather all year round.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I must admit,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: after lighting fires and hunting together out in the wild,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: it feels kind of strange for us

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: to be communicating through something like this.
It does feel kinda odd, hehe.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Have you been able to use any of the survival techniques I taught you?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I imagine that you could find yourself in all sorts of extreme situations

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: when you're out on a mission.
Hmm...
I ruminate over some of the recent missions.
I think there were a few.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: What'd you end up using?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I feel so proud already!
We ran out of emergency rations in the forest.
We ran out of water in the desert.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: But the forest is a food source in and of itself!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: It's teeming with wildlife, mushrooms, and fruit.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: So long as you can distinguish the poisonous ones from the non-poisonous ones,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: you could have a veritable feast on your hands.
So, just like you taught me, I suggested that we eat some beetles.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: What happened then?
They gave me a deadly glare.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: In the desert, hydration is of paramount importance.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Running out of water is tantamount to disaster.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Your best bet would be to gather what water you could from some plant life.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: If that's not possible, you'd have to collect dew using a container of some kind.
That's what I suggested.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: What happened then?
They looked at me with a pitiful gaze.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Don't worry too much about what other people say.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: In life-threatening situations, improvisation is key.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Things that may seem completely out of left field could end up saving your life.
I know, but I still felt awkward.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Trust me, I understand what you mean.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I get plenty of strange looks from my squadmates all the time.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Just keep at it.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: The most important thing in survival is not conforming to common sense

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: or avoiding embarrassment,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: but rather protecting the lives of our comrades.
That's a great way to think about it.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: The next time we meet,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'll teach you some even better survival techniques.
Looking forward to it.
